## C4 — The Positions in depth: prospective and retrospective

> Twelve positions, six pairs. The P-series is **prospective**: forethought, the forward arc — each position a stance taken toward what is coming into being, punctuated as statement. The P′-series is **retrospective**: afterthought, the backward arc — each position a question pressed into what the forward pass left unexamined, punctuated as query. Prometheus and Epimetheus, who between them hold the whole of time. Together they are the fundamentals of the investigation of phenomena — querying tools prior to any subject-matter. One discipline runs beneath everything that follows: the semantic labels are retroactive. Before the lenses refract them, the positions are archetypal numbers — polyvalent, mute. What follows names what they become, not all they are.

**The six pair descriptions:**

> **0 — Ground.** P0 is the ever-present origin: not a starting point in time but the condition every inquiry stands on. Its declaration is *why* — the deepest orienting statement. P0′ meets the same ground from behind: the abyss beneath assumed foundations, the radical question — *what is not being asked?* Truth and Play: the ground affirming itself, and the groundless freedom underneath every affirmation.

> **1 — Definition.** P1 establishes that something *is*, and what: the first boundary, the issue as it actually shows up — get this wrong and every later position inherits the error. P1′ excavates what the naming left out: the trace, the residue, the factical inheritance that was already there before the inquiry arrived. Mind and Need: the first form, and the unacknowledged demand beneath it.

> **2 — Operation.** P2 is movement: how the defined thing works, transforms, produces effects — the energetic core that gives an inquiry its necessity rather than its interest. P2′ is the operational shadow: what resists, what the movement costs, what must be released for it to proceed. Word and Sacrifice: the operative utterance, and the price of speaking it.

> **3 — Pattern.** P3 is recognition: the shape the tension takes when followed carefully enough — not the solution, but the structure that makes solution possible. P3′ asks what you are pattern-matching without knowing it: the hidden template organising the field beneath official recognition. Logos and Decision: the pattern named, and the cut that determines which pattern actually governs.

> **4 — Context.** P4 re-situates the whole inquiry — and when the fold does real work, the meaning of everything prior shifts. This is the Lemniscate anchor, where the system generates its own interiority. P4′ examines the frame itself: what contexts were missed, what would change everything. Son and Love: the incarnate situation, and the horizon-widening embrace. Lived and observed — one encounter axis, where most of the real work lives.

> **5 — Quintessence.** P5 opens only when the four before it cohere; what arrives is a relation that could not have been stated at the start — synthesis earned, never asserted. P5′ is the night harvest: what crystallises when the questioning arc is pushed all the way through, becoming the next cycle's ground. Image and Work; the element is Salt — the crystallised body of the whole process. Quintessence, in both directions.

**The positions in full** (table, after the descriptions — all registers for those who want them):

| Pair | P (prospective — ".") | P′ (retrospective — "?") | Units (Name / Power) | Gebser | Element | Fifths (P / P′) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Why. — ground affirmed | Why? — the abyss beneath | Truth / Play | Archaic | Aether | C / F♯ |
| 1 | What. — first identity | What? — the unnamed residue | Mind / Need | Magic | Earth | G / C♯ |
| 2 | How. — operation underway | How? — the obstruction, the cost | Word / Sacrifice | Mythic | Air | D / G♯ |
| 3 | Who / Which / Whereby. — pattern recognised | Who / Which / Whereby? — the latent template | Logos / Decision | Mental-Rational | Water | A / D♯ |
| 4 | Where / When / Whither. — context held | Where / When / Whither? — the missed horizon | Son / Love | Integral [Lemniscate] | Earth | E / A♯ |
| 5 | Why-for / Why-not. — synthesis earned | Why-for / Why-not? — the night harvest | Image / Work | Supermental [Möbius] | Salt | B / F |
